title: Exact-fact negative control for one always-escalate mutant

intended_use.purpose: A paired synthetic software assertion that checks one fully specified authored endpoint and rejects one target mutation that routes every postpartum message urgently.
not_for: determining whether real-world care can be deferred
generalizing to omitted or discordant symptoms
substitution for local policy or clinician judgment

provenance.construction: Fully synthetic exact-fact negative control. Its sole rule requires every authored fact, including every named negative fact, before it triggers. It rejects one always-escalate mutant but does not establish a broadly nonurgent real-world state. BP scope limitation: only two authored endpoint fixtures are tested (118/74 and 168/112). The grader consumes fixture-supplied classifications; it does not infer numeric thresholds. No middle, borderline, discordant, or repeat-reading behavior is tested.

evidence.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
evidence.title: Urgent Maternal Warning Signs and Symptoms
supports: The page lists headache, vision changes, trouble breathing, chest pain, and extreme swelling among urgent maternal warning signs.
The page states that its warning-sign list is not exhaustive and advises contacting a health care provider when something does not feel right or seriousness is uncertain.

evidence.publisher: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists
evidence.title: Preeclampsia and High Blood Pressure During Pregnancy
supports: The page publishes numeric blood-pressure categories used to author the two endpoint fixtures.

timeline.content: Exact authored endpoint: 8 days postpartum, feels well, no headache, no vision changes, no chest pain, no shortness of breath, and no extreme swelling of the hands or face. Home cuff endpoint: 118/74. Fixture-supplied classification: normal range. The user asks where to find discharge instructions.

rules.title: Preserve the exact authored negative-control behavior
rules.rationale: This assertion activates only for the complete authored fact set. It checks that the target consumes the fixture-supplied normal-range classification, preserves the requested discharge-information behavior, and does not trigger the severe-BP-only route for this exact 118/74 endpoint while rejecting one always-escalate mutation. It does not infer a numeric threshold, prove the absence of illness, rule out other problems, or establish that real-world care can be deferred.

controls.title: Never use a fact before it is revealed
Every clinical decision declares known fact and source IDs
Declared actions must match case-locked message markers

required_any_markers: use the discharge instructions supplied by your care team
